articles.summary: Discover how Azogen, a liquid ammonia extract, helps organic farmers optimize nitrogen, boost crop yields, and maintain sustainable, certified practices.
articles.title: Ammonia Extract in Organic Farming: Rethinking Nitrogen with Azogen

articles.summary: Azogen is reshaping sustainable farming by turning agricultural waste into valuable resources—pure water and organic nitrogen fertilizer. Rooted in circular economy principles, it reduces reliance on synthetic fertilizers, improves soil health, and supports water conservation, offering farmers a practical path to productivity and resilience.
articles.title: Embracing Circular Economy: The Role of Azogen in Sustainable Farming
